final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, attendance_count, 1.0 * attendance_count / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(attendance_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM city_shares CROSS JOIN overall WHERE share > overall.average_share
